added: The four startup screens that stop the app (newer data, data too old to open, a backup that couldn't be made, data that couldn't be moved) now have a **Copy details** button and a link to the Releases page. The newer-data screen also shows which storage versions are involved, and every one of them tells you to reopen the app once the problem is fixed.
changed: A scrubbed diagnostics export now keeps the short, fixed description of a failed update download, online import, published-collection download or sync, so a report can tell a timeout from a 404. Other error messages are still left out.
The FAQ now lists where the diagnostics log is on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS.
`CrashLogRecord.scrubbed` keeps the message of an error type listed in `CrashLogRecord.messageSafeErrorTypes` (still path-scrubbed) instead of withholding it.
